tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The azure of the logo's sphere — the largest colour in the mark. Primary buttons, fee figures, section eyebrows, active tabs and progress. Text on it: `on-brand`.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of `brand` fills; the deeper blue at the sphere's edge.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Azure tint: fee wells, selected course rows, brand badge grounds, icon wells.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `brand` and `brand-deep` fills (6.2:1 light, 5.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Azure text on `surface` and `surface-raised` (6.9:1 light, 7.2:1 dark) — fees, eyebrows, links, the blue half of the hero headline.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: The deep navy of the sphere's core and of the prospectus course pills. Sidebars, hero bands, footer, table headers on dark.

tokens.name: navy-deep
tokens.usage: Hover state of navy fills; the footer band.

tokens.name: navy-soft
tokens.usage: Navy tint: info badges, selected nav rows.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `navy` and `navy-deep` (11.2:1 light, 15.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent-on-navy
tokens.usage: Orange text on `navy` grounds (5.9:1 light, 7.9:1 dark); plain `accent` is too faint there.

tokens.name: navy-ink
tokens.usage: Navy text and links on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` (10.3:1 light, 9.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The amber-orange of the strokes inside the mark. Enrolling and fee payment, highlight ribbons, ratings, the active sidebar bar. Text on it: `on-accent`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on `accent` fills (6.4:1). Never white.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Amber text on light grounds (5.8:1 light, 9.6:1 dark) — highlighted meta. Never body copy.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Highlight and holiday badge grounds, featured wells.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background: white in light, near-black (not pure black) in dark.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, modals, inputs. In dark, one step lighter than the page.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table headers, filter bars, input groups, skeletons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on cards, tables and dividers.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders and control outlines (3.4:1 light, 3.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on every surface (16.4:1 on white).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, meta rows and captions on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken` (≥5.5:1 light, ≥6.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success fills: completed progress bars, paid-fee dots. Always with a word.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Success text — 'Completed', 'Fee paid', 'Verified' (7.4:1 on white, 6.4:1 on `success-soft`).

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success badge and toast grounds.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons and error borders. Warm and clearly apart from the azure brand; always paired with a word.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Error text and field messages (5.7:1 light, 7.5:1 dark on `danger-soft`).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error toast and danger-zone wells.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element (≥6:1 on all surfaces).

tokens.name: line-hover
tokens.usage: Borders of hovered cards, chips and inputs.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: The soft azure glow behind the home hero and page heads. The only gradient outside artwork.

tokens.name: banner
tokens.usage: The one solid blue band: the home banner, the dashboard welcome and the login panel. Text on it: `on-brand` (6.2:1 light, 5.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: header-bg
tokens.usage: The public header once the page scrolls. Nearly solid, so bright content scrolling underneath doesn't show through as blurred patches.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Dashboard sidebar ground.

tokens.name: alt
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons: a quiet grey fill (light grey on dark, as on the reference site). Text on it: `on-alt`.

tokens.name: on-alt
tokens.usage: Text on `alt` (15:1).

tokens.name: alt-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered secondary buttons.

tokens.name: alt-line
tokens.usage: Secondary button border (matches the fill in dark).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The soft halo around a focused input, outside its `focus` border.

styles.name: display-xl

styles.usage: Home hero headline only: two lines, centred. 40px under 720px.

styles.name: pill

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Meta rows, helper text, table secondary text.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows above section titles, in `accent-ink` or `brand-ink`.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Certificate IDs, enrollment IDs, receipt numbers.

tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, table chips.

tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, modals.

shadow.note: Flat by default: hairline borders do the separating. Shadows only lift what floats or is hovered; in dark, resting cards have none.

tokens.usage: Resting cards and inputs.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Hovered cards and dropdowns.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals, hero media, the certificate.
